The focus of security is not to disable the computer version, but to insist on: initiating association with the official entrance, knowing which sessions are hanging, and enforcing a short life cycle in public environments.

Recommended security workflow

  1. Open the official WhatsApp on your phone → Linked devices → Link new devices.
  2. Only open the official desktop program on your computer, or write the official website address by hand in the browser address bar.
  3. scanningThe code that just popped up from the official page on the computer screen, do not scan chat pictures.
  4. For private computers, you can check to stay logged in; for public computers, never check it, and log out immediately on the mobile phone.
  5. Check the list every week and kick out inactive but unfamiliar items.

expressly prohibited

  • Scan the "Login", "Vote" and "Subsidy" QR codes in the chat.
  • Click on "WhatsApp Web" in the search engine ad.
  • Let someone else use your mobile phone to scan on your behalf and "Hang it up for me".
  • For a long time, the company's front desk computer was used as a server 24 hours a day.

Multi-device office strategy

When you have two computers at home and one at work, naming the session makes it easy to identify; before leaving your job or selling the device, you must first remove the association on the mobile phone and then reinstall the system.

Abnormal coordination signal

The message shows that it has been read but you did not open it; the contact says that you sent a strange attachment - immediately check the association list and reset the two-step verification.

Make "cleaning the website on Sunday night" as much of a chore as taking out the trash: 30 seconds can change a week of peace of mind.

summary

The computer version is a community of productivity and risk. Official entrance, short conversation, and weekly list, when used well, it is a tool rather than a floor-to-ceiling window.

Browser extensions and shared computers

When using the web version of the browser, a malicious extension may read the page DOM. Try to use incognito mode + official website on public or company computers, and clear the data when finished. Don’t mix a large number of irrelevant add-ons with WhatsApp Web on the same browser login.

If a company deploys Chromium uniformly, IT is required to review the extension list, which is an extension of personal protection.

Multiple tabs and forgetting to log out

Some people open WhatsApp Web in several browser profiles and forget to close it after a long time. It is recommended to name each configuration file and delete it according to the name when clearing the device on the mobile phone. The company's IT policy requiring a single browser configuration can actually reduce the probability of forgetting to log out.

Sleep and screensaver

Office computer screensavers are short and passwords are required to return to your seat, which can prevent colleagues from seeing customers chatting when they pass by. Combined with WhatsApp Web to log out in time on the mobile phone, it is more reliable than relying solely on "colleagues are good people". Pressing Win+L or equivalent to lock the screen when leaving your desk should be muscle memory.

Summary retelling

Do two things before leaving your desk: lock your computer and clear the web page. It's more worry-free than worrying about "whether it's okay" after get off work.

When casting company meetings, exit WhatsApp desktop notifications first to avoid private OTP being broadcast live on the big screen in the conference room.

Do not mix the same weak master password in the browser's password saving function with WhatsApp Web.

Uninstalling the browser plug-in before logging into the web version can reduce the risk of being hijacked.

18-block-report.title: Blocking, reporting and external help: cutting off scammers’ ability to continue fighting
18-block-report.excerpt: From blocking the report in the app to notifying the bank and the police, we compiled a list of actions to "not continue to be victimized, nor to let the address book continue to be victimized."
18-block-report.body:
When encountering harassment or fraud, if the conversation stops at "a few words" or "has been read without replying", the other party will continue to change numbers to test and regard your silence as a target for training. What is more effective is: immediately stop chatting, block, report, preserve evidence, and escalate to banking and law enforcement channels when funds are involved.

Standard operations within the app

  1. Open a conversation → contact information or group information.
  2. chooseblockade, blocking subsequent messages and calls.
  3. choosereport, submit according to the prompts, and recent chats can be attached for review by the platform.
  4. Spam group: report it after exiting to avoid being pulled back repeatedly.

Reporting helps the platform cluster fraud networks. Although it does not guarantee immediate arrest, it can reduce the exposure of others.

External procedures when accounts are stolen

  1. First recapture the main session and technical backdoor.
  2. Use text messages/phone calls/email announcements, not just to express injustice on WhatsApp to those who have been accused.
  3. If there is a loss of money: the bank stops payment, retains evidence, and reports the case through local police channels if necessary.

Evidence package recommendations

  • Screenshot of the full text of the chat (including the other party’s number and time).
  • Transfer records and payee information.
  • Copy the phishing URL in plain text (do not click again).
  • Associated device exception screenshots and SMS code time.

For anti-fraud inquiries, please go to the official help center or local anti-fraud publicity channels, and do not give remote control rights to "enthusiastic netizens".

When is the spread warning

If the scam uses your stolen account to spread to your address book, you should briefly clarify it in multiple groups after recovering it, once only, and attach verifiable non-WhatsApp contact information.

summary

Blocking reports shortens the attacker's range; asking for help reduces financial losses. Have lists in both hands rather than winging it.

Realistic expectations for reporting materials

Electronic evidence must retain the original carrier, and screenshots should include the other party’s account number, time, and complete context as much as possible. Whether a case can be filed and how to collaborate cross-border shall be judged by the case-handling agency in accordance with the law; this website cannot replace legal advice. You should still report it to create a time record and help with the bank's dispute process.

The reality of transnational scams

WhatsApp fraud is often transnational and it is difficult to recover the stolen goods, but it still makes sense to report the crime and dispute it with the bank. Handing all the materials to the case-handling agency at once is more effective than posting in fragments on various platforms. Families should manage expectations while adhering to payment stops and timelines.

Linkage outside the platform

The same scammer may be copying the script on Telegram, Line. After a platform is blocked, pay attention to whether other apps come to connect. Record scam numbers and IDs in your personal blacklist and share them with your family to reduce repeated scams.

Post review meeting

After being scammed or nearly scammed, families do a 20-minute review: What step could have been taken to say no? Which setting should be improved next week? No accountability, just change the process. Post the review record on the refrigerator so that similar words will trigger your memory next time.

Briefly describe the scam routine to relatives and friends. One circle of friends is worth more than a hundred times of being alone; be careful to hide sensitive personal account information.

Record the receipt number reported to the platform to facilitate follow-up or supplementary materials.

After reporting to WhatsApp, you should still back up the evidence locally. Processing by the platform does not mean the case is settled.

Save nickname variations that scammers have used on other platforms to facilitate cross-retrieval and warning.

19-family-elders.title: Family and Elder Protection Class: Turn complex safety into enforceable family rules
19-family-elders.excerpt: A long version of the home anti-theft plan: family rules, role-playing drills, remote assistance boundaries, and how to help elders complete key settings.
19-family-elders.body:
Many family stories begin when an elder receives the message "Read the code for me." It’s not that they don’t have good intentions, but they put politeness before vigilance. Scammers take advantage of the psychology of "embarrassment to refuse" and "fear of delaying the child". To protect the elders, it is not to throw them a long article, but to translate complex safety intoAble to memorize, act, and refusehouse rules.

Six house rules for refrigerator magnets

  1. No one will give the verification code, including my children and "customer service".
  2. To borrow money, you must call the old phone number and do not transfer it in the app.
  3. Do not click on the "Unblock/Winning/Vote" link.
  4. Videos do not share the screen with strangers.
  5. Spend half a minute every Sunday looking at "Connected Devices."
  6. Use two-step verification for the whole family. Remember the PIN yourself or your children can keep it for you.

15-minute hands-on family lesson

  1. The children were present to help each elder open two-step verification and register their email address.
  2. Clear the associated devices together and turn off the lock screen verification code preview.
  3. Practice the liar's lines and three rejection lines, swapping roles.
  4. Make an agreement to "call the digital contact first if you are not sure" and establish a culture of no guilt.
  5. Write down a list of emergency phone numbers (children, community, bank) and post it next to the refrigerator.

The limits of remote assistance

You can video-guide your elders on the settings, but don’t let them install remote software from unknown sources. Children will never ask for verification codes from their parents to "operate on their behalf" - it is more important to model correct behavior than to click buttons for them.

How to communicate after being fooled

Solve the problem first and then educate: assist in recapture, bank stop payment, and comfort. Blaming will only make them hide it next time, until the damage is greater.

The goal is not to turn elders into experts, but to give them the courage to "hang up" at critical moments.

summary

House rules + walkthroughs + key settings are a long-term investment. One lesson today may block the entire building's chain of scam codes next year.

Risks of Community and Church Support Groups

Elders often have a strong sense of trust in their faith and neighborhood groups. You can ask the group owner to pin the "Assistant Cai will not issue verification code" announcement to the top of the page, and have your children occasionally drop in to share it for 10 minutes. Using group norms to reduce individual rejection pressure.

A tutorial on screenshots of large fonts is prepared for people with poor vision. Paths are more friendly than text.

Combined with anti-fraud propaganda

Many city public security agencies have anti-fraud brochures or short videos, which you can watch with your elders to discuss important scenes in the plot. Official materials are often more convincing than children’s nagging. When encountering real news about being deceived, we should also have a gentle discussion about "how should we refuse if it is true?"

Drug and supplement scams intersect

The rhetoric of selling health care products often goes hand in hand with asking for codes to steal accounts: first gain trust, and then ask for verification codes to "activate membership prices." When the elders return home after attending a health lecture, their children can take the initiative to ask, "Have you registered to receive a code on your mobile phone today?" Concerned questions are more effective than questioning.

Work with community centers

If there are smartphone training classes in streets or communities, you can sign up instead of singles for your children. Group learning reduces loneliness and the frustration of “I’m the stupid one.” Strive to have verification code discipline written into classroom handouts.

Encourage elders to forward suspicious chats to their children to “have a look” and give them the right to ask for help.

When taking family photos at holiday gatherings and sending them to WeChat Moments, avoid showing bank cards and express delivery orders in the background.

The first Sunday of every month is set as Family Safety Day, and a ten-minute inspection is all it takes.

20-encryption-myths.title: End-to-end encryption doesn’t mean it won’t be stolen: The boundaries you need to know
20-encryption-myths.excerpt: Encryption is important, but it doesn’t verify who’s on the other side, and it doesn’t protect your unlocked screen, misconfigured cloud backups, or verification codes you actively hand over.
20-encryption-myths.body:
The phrase "WhatsApp is safe" has been repeated so many times in the media and in classrooms that many people mistakenly believe that:With encryption turned on, you will not be cheated, stolen, or leaked.In fact, end-to-end encryption mainly solves the problem of "intermediate link eavesdropping". It is not automatically immune to the verification code you hand over, the associated web page, the screen read by Trojans, and the proliferation of screenshots of the recipient.

What does encryption actually protect?

  • Confidentiality of personal chats and calls along the transmission path (within official design assumptions).
  • Reduces the traditional risk of carriers and public Wi-Fi eavesdropping on clear text chat content.
  • Together with key management, it forms an important part of the product security narrative.

What encryption doesn’t automatically protect

  • After you tell the "customer service" your registration code and PIN, the other party logs in legally to do evil.
  • An attacker synchronizes reading history and real-time messages through associated devices.
  • Unlocked shoulder viewing, screen recording, and remote sharing on mobile phones.
  • The recipient forwards, screenshots, and backs up to an unsecured cloud.
  • The second copy is leaked due to unencrypted cloud backup or improper key storage.
  • Whether the identity of the other person is who you think it is - encryption does not identify the person.

In a word: Just because the pipe is tight doesn’t mean the counter is genuine, nor does it mean you will give the key to a stranger.

How to create a "complete sense of security"

Treat encryption as the first layer, superimposing: verification code discipline, two-step verification, related equipment inspection, official client, backup key management, and dual-channel transfer core. If any piece is missing, social workers can find a way around it.

Words to explain to family members

"Encryption is like sealing a car, but if you take the initiative to open the door and let people in, the car cannot be saved no matter how sealed it is." Use metaphors to reduce resistance.

summary

Respect cryptography, but don’t mythologize cryptography. What HoldLine wants to make up for is the large piece of real risk map "beyond end-to-end".

A reminder for journalists and activists

Source protection relies not just on encryption, but also on device physical security, contact authentication, and backup policies. If you are engaged in sensitive work, you should use dedicated mobile phones and semicolon operations, and conduct regular threat model reviews instead of relying on a single switch.

Group chats and communities

Community-themed, large-scale group chats sometimes do not enjoy the same end-to-end default model as individual chats (depending on official instructions and group type). When participating in a public group, assume that the content may be seen by administrators or mechanisms outside of the reporting process. Don't equate "told it in the group" with "absolutely private".

Forward chains and rumors

The source of pseudo-official announcements forwarded in encrypted chats is often outside the scope of encryption protection - the problem is that you believe the content. Cultivating the habit of "checking the official help center first before switching" will protect your family and friends better than arguing about technical details.

Summary retelling

Trust encryption and trust your own operation process. The next time someone reaches for a code, think of this article: That's really trying to get through a pipe.

Forward this article to friends who like to say "WhatsApp is absolutely safe" and use examples to correct the deviation.

Corporate training has been added to this Quiz section, and questions with a high error rate among employees will be highlighted in the next issue.

After reading this article, go check the associated equipment and remember the boundaries through actions.

Re-read the official safety page when the technical terms are updated, and don’t rely on impressions from three years ago and contemporary facts.

21-encrypted-backup.title: Chat backup and end-to-end encrypted backup: Protect your data as well as your keys
21-encrypted-backup.excerpt: Backups are a life saver and can also turn into a second copy of chats. How to enable encrypted backup, keep passwords/keys/passkeys, and what must be checked before switching devices.
21-encrypted-backup.body:
Backup has saved countless phone changes and lost phones, and may also be a second copy of complete chat history. WhatsApp supports backing up chats to iCloud/Google Cloud, and can turn on end-to-end encrypted backup, making it difficult for cloud service providers to read the content directly if configured correctly. But if you lose the key slip, "can be backed up" will also become "can never be found".

Is it recommended to enable

  • There are a lot of work and family communications that need to be retained: it is recommended to back up + turn on end-to-end encryption.
  • Extremely sensitive conversations: Assess chat locks, disappearing messages, and realize the recipient can still take screenshots.
  • Company compliance requirements for record retention: Confirm backup storage location and access control with legal affairs.

Open path (subject to common versions)

  1. Settings → Chat → Chat Backup.
  2. Enter end-to-end encrypted backup.
  3. Follow the prompts to create a password, 64-bit key, or passkey (depending on device support).
  4. Write recovery method into password manager + offline safe location (paper envelope, safe).

Officials and security agencies have stated that after the password/key for encrypted backup is lost, the platform usually cannot recover it for you. Safekeeping and backup are equally important.

Plans for machine replacement and machine loss

  1. Before switching machines, confirm that the latest backup was successful.
  2. Test once: whether you can still find the key.
  3. After the recovery is completed, immediately inspect the two-step verification and associated devices.
  4. When the computer is lost, first seize account sovereignty, and then handle cloud backup permissions (email, cloud account).

Common misunderstandings

  • Send a photo of the key to WeChat "just in case" - it's equivalent to clear text hosting.
  • Thinking that "only I can see" the unencrypted backup - the cloud account is stolen and I run away naked.
  • The company lets employees back up their work groups with their private accounts, and data management gets out of control after they leave.

summary

Backup is a double-edged sword: encryption + key management can prevent data loss and prevent another copy from being leaked.

Pitfalls of family shared cloud accounts

When a couple shares an iCloud/Google account, if the encrypted backup key exists in only one person's mind, neither party may be able to recover it if the phone is lost. Keys should be recorded using a common safe or individually backed up to a controlled enterprise password vault. Remember to rotate cloud login and backup permissions when you get divorced or split up.

Restoration drill annual course

Once a year, try restoring the encrypted backup on the backup machine to confirm that the key is still correct. The drill can reveal hidden problems such as cloud account arrears and key corruption. When you really lose your chance, your mentality will be much calmer.

law enforcement retrieval boundary

Different jurisdictions have different rules for cloud retrieval. End-to-end encrypted backups make retrieval more difficult, but they do not make legal judgments for you. Consult a licensed attorney when involved in a case; just prepare a strategy for owning your own keys and legally retaining them.

Summary retelling

When the backup success light turns on, sync checks whether the key is still there. Two green lights are required to complete the process.

Tell your family where the key is (not the password itself) so no one can recover important conversations if you pass out.

The team's shared key is controlled by two people to prevent one person from leaving and taking away all recovery rights.

Enable login reminders for cloud accounts to prevent backup channels from being breached by bypass.

The notebook records the date of the last successful backup, and if it has not been backed up for more than 30 days, the mobile phone will remind you.

Before major litigation, decide whether to suspend automatic backup according to the lawyer's opinion to avoid accidentally deleting the evidence chain.

22-app-lock-biometrics.title: App Lock and Biometrics: Adding a Door Lock to WhatsApp
22-app-lock-biometrics.excerpt: After the phone is unlocked, App Lock can block prying eyes when opening it easily. Explain how to enable it and its division of labor with system lock screen and chat lock.
22-app-lock-biometrics.body:
The system lock screen blocks "a stranger picks up the phone"; the WhatsApp application lock blocks "the phone is unlocked but the person leaves for half a minute" - family members click on it, colleagues borrow photos to look at, and children swipe the screen randomly. The officially provided second-step verification of fingerprint, face or device credentials (the name varies depending on the version) is a low-friction enhancement.

Start steps

  1. WhatsApp Settings → Privacy (or Security) → App Lock / Fingerprint Lock.
  2. Follow the prompts to verify your system biometrics or PIN.
  3. Confirm that the auto-lock time (immediate or 1 minute) is consistent with your custom.
  4. Check if notification quick replies bypass locks (tweaked by version).

Division of labor with other protection

  • System lock screen:The first one is a must.
  • App lock:The second step is to prevent the environment from being unlocked.
  • Chat lock:Hide and re-open a single session.
  • Two-step verification:The main force for remote account hacking, complementary to application lock.

limitations and cautions

App lock cannot stop you from handing your phone to a scammer to scan the associated code, nor can it stop you from sending the verification code. Biometric identification may be forced to unlock in some judicial scenarios, and people with high sensitivity can evaluate the pure PIN strategy.

The three minutes it takes to turn on App Lock often end up regretting paying for "borrowing the phone for a minute".

summary

The application lock is a small personal lock that forms a bedroom door + safe combination with the system lock screen, rather than a replacement.

Differences between different brands of mobile phones

Some domestic customized systems will require you to re-unlock WhatsApp after killing the background; you can whitelist WhatsApp in battery optimization to avoid the application lock being ineffective and annoying to turn off the function. iPhone users should also be aware of the exposure of notification previews in lock screen widgets.

If you temporarily turn off biometrics (injury, gloves) while traveling, make sure the system PIN is strong enough rather than disabling App Lock entirely.

Accessibility in case of emergency

If you are worried that your family will not be able to read WhatsApp to contact the doctor in the event of a sudden illness, you can prepare a medical contact card written in a separate envelope instead of closing the app lock for a long time. Security and accessibility can be designed in layers: daily locks, emergency information on paper or phone quick dial.

Fingerprint recognition decline in old age

If the recognition fails when the fingerprint is worn, the elderly may angrily close the app lock. Use your device PIN as a fallback for App Lock instead, or record a few extra fingers. It is better to be patient and debug once than to run naked for a long time.

List of model differences

Samsung, Xiaomi, and OPPO have different menu paths. When you buy a new phone and migrate, you need to re-enable the app lock. Don't assume that Switch Assistant will inherit security settings. Keep the electronic version of the manual and check the check items during the replacement week.

Explain the purpose of App Lock to people who often lend your phone to take pictures to reduce accidental deletions.

It is still recommended to turn on the app lock when charging at night and putting it in the bedroom to prevent your partner from misinforming your child about inappropriate content.

Instructional video sent to elders: How to open and close the app lock to reduce mis-opening.

It is normal for fingerprints to fail when your hands are wet. The backup PIN should be easy to remember but not the same six-digit number.

Users with disabled hands can use system accessibility alternatives without having to turn off the entire machine lock screen.

After changing the bangs film on a business trip, re-enter the fingerprint to reduce accidental locking.

23-chat-lock-disappearing.title: Chat locking, ephemeral and disappearing messages: reducing residual exposure
23-chat-lock-disappearing.excerpt: These functions cannot prevent the account from being taken over, but they can reduce the risk of the phone being browsed and historical messages retained for a long time. Also understand that screenshots and reposts still exist.
23-chat-lock-disappearing.body:
Even if the account has not been stolen, retaining the information for a long time will bring risks such as disputes, leakage after a breakup, and misunderstandings among colleagues. WhatsApp provides functions such as chat locking, disappearing messages by default, and one-time viewing of media to reduce "old conversations lying on the phone." They cannot prevent account takeover, but they can reduce the probability of physical review and old records being dug out.

chat lock

The specified chat can be moved to a locked folder, and opening requires re-verification of biometrics or PIN. The list does not display content previews by default. Suitable for sharing mobile phones or situations where you don’t want the conversation to be seen at a glance. Note: A record may still be left on the other party's device; locking does not replace 2-step verification.

disappear message

  • Cycles such as 24 hours/7 days/90 days can be enabled for individual chats (subject to the version).
  • Reduces the risk of "a sentence from three years ago being screenshotted", but cannot prevent instant screenshots and forwarding.
  • It is necessary to communicate with members before starting a group chat to avoid misunderstandings and evidence being deleted.

View media all at once

Suitable for sending sensitive pictures/videos. The recipient can only open it once, and there is a mechanism to limit screenshots (subject to official capabilities). You still have to trust that the other party will not use a second device to remake the video.

Use boundaries

These features are not bulletproof; account sovereignty still relies on verification code discipline and related equipment inspections. It will not prove to the other party for you that "this statement has never existed" - please consult a professional for legal scenarios.

Make an agreement with your family: You must verbally inform the disappearing message before opening it to avoid arguments over "Why did you delete it?"

summary

Use locked and disappearing messages as hygiene tools: less dirt does not mean no dirt. Sovereign security still depends on doorknobs and keys.

Balance point in communication with customers

If disappearing messages are turned on in business chat, it may conflict with the "queryable records" expected by customers. You can use lock chat + disappear internally, and retain emails or CRM copies externally; industries with legal retention obligations need to consult compliance. Technology and systems must be designed together.

Difficulties in Obtaining Evidence from Disputes

Disappearing messages may leave you without chat records when defending your rights. For transactions that may require evidence, use email or a time-stamped contract system to leave traces; disappearing messages are suitable for purely emotional or low-controversy scenarios. Think beforehand, "Will these words still be there in a year's time?" before choosing a strategy.

Locking and Guardianship of Minors

When parents lock sensitive chats for their children, they should also maintain crisis dialogue channels (such as direct phone calls) to prevent their children from being in danger but unable to call for help due to the lock. Lockdown is about reducing exposure, not cutting off parent-child communication.

Summary retelling

Disappearing messages are suitable for low-risk small talk; please use auditable channels for contracts and money topics. Feature selection matches risk level.

Check the locked chat list regularly and delete items you no longer need to reduce the risk of forgetting to open it.

Before writing a lawyer's letter or defending your rights, please inquire whether you need to retain the original chat export record.

After updating the system, re-enable the disappearing message option to prevent upgrade reset.

When the work machine and personal account are separated, they each evaluate different disappearing message strategies.

After backup and restoration, check whether the chat lock directory is still in effect and re-lock it if necessary.

Inform the other party of your expectations before opening the disappearing message to avoid misunderstandings about cooperation.

Export necessary chat PDFs the night before a major system version upgrade for future reference.

Tonight, open a lock chat to check whether it takes effect, ten seconds.

24-business-vs-personal.title: Business ID and Personal ID: Anti-theft and anti-counterfeiting in store operations
24-business-vs-personal.excerpt: Customer base, order communication, employee management - business scenarios have additional risks. How to isolate permissions and prevent mass fraud after the customer service account is taken over.
24-business-vs-personal.body:
Stolen personal accounts hurt family and friends; stolen store, micro-business, and customer service accounts will send "temporary payment code replacement" and "additional freight payment" to customers within a few hours, directly damaging the brand and cash flow. Business scenarios are also superimposed with amplification factors such as employee hosting, multi-machine login, and tablet placement at the counter.

Permissions and architecture recommendations

  • The main business account must be opened for two-step verification, and the PIN must be placed in the corporate password database, and it will be rotated upon resignation.
  • Limit the number of associated devices and remove all mobile devices on the day employees leave.
  • Public tablets are not allowed to hang up sessions 24 hours a day; set a strong screen lock and app lock.
  • The collection account is regularly disclosed to the public and customers are educated: temporary code changes in chat require a second confirmation.

Customer Clarification Template

"The payment account of our store is subject to the store notice/official website. If you ask to change the payment method through WhatsApp private message, please call the store first to verify." The earlier you send it, the less likely you are to follow the trend of transfers.

Three mistakes in employee training

  1. You are not allowed to send the store number verification code to your personal WeChat to help you log in.
  2. Do not scan unfamiliar "merchant certification" or "traffic support" codes.
  3. If an abnormal mass message is found: disconnect the conversation first, follow the recapture process, and clarify through all channels.

Isolate from personal number

If it can be solved with enterprise tools, don't put all customers on private accounts; even if you are still operating on personal accounts, you must separate devices, PINs, and backup strategies.

Write "customer fund security" into the KPI and assess awareness alongside sales.

summary

Business number theft prevention is a business continuity project. The permissions are minimized, the equipment is listed, and the payment verification is standardized, which is cheaper than a public relations draft.

Multi-platform payment consistency

In addition to WhatsApp, customers may also inquire on Facebook and Instagram. All channels publicize the same set of collection accounts, and take regular screenshots and archives. When employees take over the account, they sign a custody agreement and make it clear that the verification code will not be shared.

Doing an "account health check" before a major promotion is easier than chasing money after the promotion.

Insurance and emergency plans

Evaluate whether commercial insurance covers customer compensation due to online fraud. Prepare a brief external statement template and temporary collection freeze process with a lawyer. Account theft is also a business continuity event and should be written into the company's emergency manual and rehearsed.

Outsourced customer service account

When outsourcing teams share customer service accounts, they must manage who logs in every day through a list; the associated equipment must be deleted at the end of the shift. The outsourcer contract includes leak liability and verification code confidentiality clauses, and training records are kept on file.

Summary retelling

Customers trust your brand, not some random WhatsApp message. By standardizing the core, the brand will not be easily penetrated by a piece of false news.

End-of-quarter inventory: Are there any unusual collections this quarter? In customer complaints, accounts are screened for fraudulent use of keywords.

The holiday duty list indicates who holds the customer service number to avoid unattended exceptions during the handover vacuum period.

New customer contracts specify official contact information to reduce bargaining space for fake accounts.

The logo watermark is added to the official poster image, making it easy for customers to identify the authenticity of the payment collection image and text.

Annual audit samples whether employees know the store number verification code confidentiality system.

At noon, the shift handover will give a verbal report on whether there are any abnormal logins, and then the business will be resumed at the next shift.

The first mobile phone you use when closing a store should be to check related equipment.

Print cashier notice: Only recognize the QR code at the counter for payment.

25-new-phone-migration.title: Anti-theft checklist for mobile phone migration: Keep your account number when switching between old and new mobile phones
25-new-phone-migration.excerpt: The switch window is the easiest to panic: backup, verification, linking devices, and two-step verification may be skipped. A migration day checklist to help you make the switch smoothly and safely.
25-new-phone-migration.body:
On the day of switching phones, the mental bandwidth is occupied by "photos transferred or not", and security settings are most easily skipped: forgetting to enable two-step verification, forgetting to kick out the old web version, or asking others to scan the link for you in the store. Attackers love this window of time - you'd rather hand over your phone to save time.

24 hours before replacement

  • Confirm that the backup is up to date and the encryption key is available.
  • Confirm that the two-step verification email can log in.
  • List computer sessions to keep and plan to reconnect after migration.
  • Write down an emergency contact number (not WhatsApp).

Order on the day of replacement

  1. Only install official WhatsApp on the new phone; start the verification while the old phone is still in hand.
  2. When entering the registration code, cover your shoulders; do not give the code to the clerk.
  3. After restoring the backup, immediately confirm that two-step verification is still on.
  4. Associated device page: Kick the old session, and then scan the QR code on the new computer as needed.
  5. Turn on app lock, check privacy and group invitation restrictions.

Old machine disposal

After confirming that the new phone is normal, exit WhatsApp or restore the old phone to factory settings; confirm again that the iCloud/Google account has been logged out before selling.

Common mistakes

  • The two machines were online at the same time for too long, and the old machine was lost and not activated.
  • I forgot to migrate the backup key, and all chats were empty.
  • The clerk scanned the unknown QR code on behalf of the operator.

Mark the calendar in red on the day of the replacement: migration in the morning and safety inspection in the afternoon, so as not to mix the two things together.

summary

The goal of migration: the only trusted master device, a clean association list, continuous two-step verification, and no key loss.

Cross-ecosystem migration (iOS ↔ Android)

When changing operating systems, WhatsApp chat history migration is limited by official tools and may not be completely transferred. Export necessary contracts and invoices to PDF in advance; be more wary of over-the-shoulder peeping when verifying numbers, because users are often anxious about operating in physical stores. After the migration is complete, be sure to redo the associated device and two-step verification. Don't assume that "the device replacement assistant will help you with security."

Data erasure certification

Before selling the old machine, use the official factory reset method and confirm that the account has been removed in the settings. Some Android models require additional SD card formatting. People who buy second-hand phones also use a new account to log in, a new two-step verification, and do not trust any remaining sessions of the previous owner.

Watches and secondary cards

If the eSIM watch can receive text messages independently, confirm which screen the verification code is sent to when migrating. After activating the new phone, test the routing of WhatsApp calls and text messages to avoid the verification code being left on the old watch and being seen by others.

Summary retelling

No matter how busy the replacement window is, there are still ten minutes left for the Five Steps to Safety. The joy of migration is based on the fact that the account is still in your own hands.

On the night of the migration, I sent a non-WhatsApp announcement to my friends: "Successful phone change, don't believe in scams."

Tear off the ICCID information on the old mobile phone card tray and packaging box before discarding.

Export CSV backup of friends' business cards, and check whether the import is complete after migration.

Enter fingerprints after the film is affixed to the new phone to avoid recognition failure caused by film replacement later.

If your child's old watch is bound to an old number, remember to unbind it and then bind it to the new phone after changing the phone.

On the night of migration, do not open unfamiliar web pages to "test speed" and focus on the official process.

The SIM pin of old phones should be stored properly to prevent it from being thrown away and picked up.

A safety review of the new machine will be conducted every night for ten minutes in the first week, which is only one week.

26-group-scams.title: Group Fraud and Administrator Risks: The Full Link from Group Pulling to False Notifications
26-group-scams.excerpt: Strange groups, fake customer service groups, and announcements after administrators are stolen—groups are areas of high-frequency fraud. Teach you how to set the threshold for group entry and identify fake notifications.
26-group-scams.body:
Groups provide the psychological safety of "most people are present", but they are also a loudspeaker for the expansion of fraud. Groups created by strangers, fake customer service groups, and phishing announcements made after the administrator's account has been stolen—all take advantage of your assumption that "not everyone in the group is a scammer."

Danger group portrait

  • After a strange account adds you to the group, it immediately forces you to add a "specialist" for a private chat.
  • There are only short links in the announcement for "real-name registration" and "subsidy receipt".
  • Time-limited threats: refund, fine, or call the police if no action is taken.
  • Screenshots are not allowed to be uploaded to outsiders, and "only listen to administrators" is required.

personal protection

  1. Privacy limits who can add you to the group.
  2. For strangers, observe first and do not click on links; exit and report if necessary.
  3. Family and company core groups: Administrators must enable two-step verification.
  4. Notices involving changes in payment collection and reimbursement: confirmation through the second channel.

Administrator Responsibilities

Regularly clean up zombie accounts; start new member review; withdraw abnormal announcements first and then clarify through multiple channels; backup deputy administrator for key groups.

Administrator account stolen

Take it back immediately → Send "Ignore the link just now" to other members → Revoke the invitation link → Rebuild the group as appropriate and verify the membership identity.

The bigger the group is, the more important it is to write a group announcement that says "confirm key points with the administrator via private message first".

summary

Groups are trust amplifiers. The group entry threshold, administrator reinforcement, and double confirmation of key actions can block most explosive scams in the group.

Fake documents in the "read-only group"

After the administrator sets the group to be read-only, scammers may use the "Documents" tab to send APKs or "Order Forms" instead. Members are reminded: group files are equally suspicious as group links. You can turn off the permission for ordinary members to send files, or write clearly "This group does not send installation packages" in the group announcement.

Investment and rebate category names often include emojis and emergency words, and keyword family filters can be set to remind each other.

On-chain enthusiasm and FOMO

Robots or shills in the group will fake screenshots of "on board" and "doubled" to create a fear of missing out. When I see the order posted, I first ask: Can it be verified on-chain? Can I confirm by voice? When the group leader makes huge profits, the default script is suspicious. There is no shame in quitting the group, but it will be difficult to speak out if the money is gone.

Fake official assistant number

Most of the "WhatsApp Assistant" and "Security Bot" that appear in the group are private accounts renamed by scammers. Genuine function notifications will not require codes via private chat. If you see a bot claiming to be a bot, ignore it and check with real official channels.

Summary retelling

It's free to leave the group, but announcements of falsehoods are expensive. If something goes wrong, retreat first and then verify. This is more important than saving face.

Propose to the group owner to enable new member approval, and one setting will benefit the entire group.

There are often benefits from raising accounts, so don’t judge the authenticity by their popularity. Thinking for a minute before taking action can avoid most FOMO.

If you have invested money in the group, stop adding money immediately, keep the evidence, and seek help through banks and formal channels.

Every group does not have to be active, and streamlining the group list equals a reduced attack surface.

For abnormal accounts that rarely speak but frequently change group names, the group owner should directly remove them.

Set invitation links to rotate regularly to reduce the risk of attracting people for a long time after leaks.

If you join the group and don't talk for a week, just post screenshots, mark it for observation.

Do not disturb at night still requires all announcements from the security group Aite.

Be suspicious first when you see a screenshot of a sudden fortune, and then make a judgment based on the logic of the benefits.

Exiting the abnormal group is not rude, it is a stop loss.

27-ai-voice-impersonation.title: AI Voice and Deep Impersonation: When “Sounding Like You” Is No Longer Enough
27-ai-voice-impersonation.excerpt: Synthetic voice also brings new risks to “call verification”. Establish stronger core questions and dual-channel confirmation to avoid relying solely on voiceprint perception.
27-ai-voice-impersonation.body:
"Always call when borrowing money" was once a golden rule, but now it needs to be upgraded: AI voice cloning can imitate the tone of your relatives and friends in a few seconds, and then match the contextual pressure in the stolen WhatsApp. Technological progress has not eliminated verification, but only increased the depth of verification.

New rule: focus on the body, not just the sounds

  • Ask random details known only to both parties to avoid fixed questions being pickpocketed in advance.
  • Request instant video to show your face + raise your hand to match a random number.
  • Enable delayed arrival or double review for large amounts.
  • The family has a default "borrowing code", and if it cannot be spoken, it will not be changed.

Old rules still apply

  • You can dial the old number in your address book without chatting with the new number.
  • Reject irreversible payments such as gift cards and virtual currency.
  • The more you press for confidentiality and immediateness, the more you have to slow down.

How to reduce cloned material

Do not post long high-definition voice/videos on public social media; privacy settings limit strangers from downloading. It cannot be completely eliminated, but it can increase the cost of attacks.

Technology is changing, but the principle remains the same: major financial actions require identity verification beyond the current chat window.

summary

Don’t give up on phone verification because of AI, make it harder: knowledge questions + video presence + late payment combo.

Upgrade process for corporate finance positions

The company should require that any change to the supplier's account must be made by calling back the phone number recorded in the contract and signed by both parties. Even if the voice sounds like the boss's, follow the process - a real boss should feel safe from the process, not offended.

Fixed greeting codes agreed by both parties can be recorded and changed from time to time to reduce the possibility of the AI ​​model overfitting historical audio.

Cross-border jet lag and sleepy decisions

Early morning phone calls are the easiest to break through the defense line. Agreed family rules: Borrowing requests between 23:00 and 7:00 will be processed after dawn. If there is a real emergency, you should go to 120/official emergency channels instead of WhatsApp transfer. AI voice + time difference is a common combination.

Public voice sample management

Podcasts and live broadcasts will leave long-term tone samples. Public figures should use delayed payment and multi-signature processes; ordinary people can also reduce sending long voice circles in public groups to reduce the quality of cloned materials.

Summary retelling

Sound can be synthesized and details are difficult to fake. Ask more questions that only a real person can answer, and the AI ​​script will often reveal its secrets.

The verification process is reiterated during the rotation of financial positions. Newcomers cannot make payments alone if they do not know the password.

The company can stipulate that two people must be present to sign the payment beyond the threshold, and the system will delay the payment by one hour to gain time for AI voice verification.

Relatives agree that the secret code should be changed every Spring Festival and should be written in the housework book instead of chatting.

Video conference recordings of large-scale decisions are kept, and whether the voice is AI can be traced afterwards.

The voice message mailbox can be short to reduce the length of training materials that are crawled in batches.

If public speaking recordings need to be released, the key may be slightly changed or BGM may be added to increase the cost of cloning.

Large-scale expenditures resolved by the board of directors still need to be signed and archived in paper.

After the lunch break, large transfers will be forced to cool down for thirty minutes before confirmation.

Couples transfer large sums to each other by voice and code, and do not skip steps because of intimacy.

When asking for money for kidnapping, first call 110 and then transfer the money.

Test your family's secret code and practice your skills.

28-teens-kids-safety.title: Teenagers using WhatsApp: Prevent account theft, inducement and guardianship boundaries
28-teens-kids-safety.excerpt: Young people are socially active and have different defenses, making them easy targets for deception and inducement. Setting suggestions, dialogue scripts and help-seeking mechanisms for parents.
28-teens-kids-safety.body:
Teenagers are better at using mobile phones than their elders, but they may not be more aware of the risks: game transactions, fan circle draws, campus rumors, and love blackmail all make "give a verification code" and "send a selfie" a matter of course. The goal of parents is not to monitor everything, but to have clear red lines and not be punished for asking for help.

Red lines agreed with children

  1. Verification codes, ID photos, and bank cards will not be given to netizens.
  2. Skin recharge is done through the official platform and no private WhatsApp transfers are allowed.
  3. Threatened to expose privacy: tell parents first, rather than paying first.
  4. Don't pretend to be the "cracked version" or "double version" passed down by your classmates.

Parental Assistance Setup

  • Turn on two-step verification; use the family negotiation plan to recover your email.
  • Limit group invitations; avatars are restrained from strangers.
  • System and App Lock are on; check associated devices together regularly.
  • Teach people to block reports instead of being abusive.

communication skills

Use case discussions instead of shaming; ensure "disclaimer of responsibility before reporting suspicious cases". Concealment is often due to fear of having the phone confiscated.

school and peers

Share official anti-fraud resources with your class teacher; encourage children to spread the word “It’s a scam” to their peers instead of ridiculing the victim twice.

Teenagers need coaching parents, not jailer parents.

summary

Education + settings + friendly help channels can reduce risks in the long term better than peeking in chats.

Campus second-hand and game play

"Low-priced skins" and "playing deposits" are often accompanied by verification code hacking or nude chatting for blackmail. Make an agreement with your children: Any assistance involving account login will be rejected and a screenshot will be sent to the parents. School psychological counseling channels should be incorporated into digital blackmail disposal.

Encouraging teenagers to be peer educators is more acceptable than simply preaching from parents.

School Rules and Digital Discipline

Cooperate with the school to write "no verification code" into the student handbook as an example, and educate it in the same batch as anti-bullying. An anonymous channel for reporting suspicious accounts will be established within the class to protect the reporter. Teenagers reminding each other is more effective than parents fighting alone.

Mental health and blackmail

Teenagers may have increased suicidal thoughts after nude chat blackmail, and parents should seek professional psychological assistance before discovering abnormal chat locks. The contract stipulates that "anything can be discussed first and dealt with later", which is more life-saving than simply confiscating the mobile phone.

Summary retelling

Children are willing to tell you early, which can reduce losses more than peeking and chatting. Write "no penalty for reporting" into the family agreement and implement it.

Share anti-fraud resources with school psychologists to let children know that they can go to the teacher if they are scolded.

Guide teenagers to pay attention to official anti-fraud accounts instead of looking for novel fraud collections to reduce the risk of imitating criminal methods.

Parents should not open modified apps themselves. Leading by example is more convincing than reasoning.

Establish a family "suspicious event bonus": proactively report scam tactics and reward milk tea coupons to provide positive incentives for reporting.

The game voice channel is also prohibited from sending verification codes, which is consistent with WhatsApp rules.

The first rule of the dormitory agreement can be written: Whoever asks for the verification code gets a treat - use humor to remember the rules.

Do not use personal WhatsApp to log in to the stadium screen together with the collective machine at the sports meeting.

You only need to forward this topic once per semester to the parent group.

The class teacher only needs to know about it, and there is no need to disclose the details of the child's deception to the whole class.

The playground number change must be reported to parents on the same day.

The class meeting shared that anti-fraud is more effective than punishment.

29-travel-roaming.title: Travel and roaming: WhatsApp anti-theft tips when traveling and on business trips
29-travel-roaming.excerpt: Changing cards, renting an airplane, hotel Wi-Fi, public computers, travel scenarios add risks. Three checklists before departure, during the trip, and after returning home.
29-travel-roaming.body:
Traveling is compounded by unfamiliar networks, temporary SIMs, eSIMs, hotel computers, and jet lag fatigue—these are four factors that make it easy for verification codes and associated devices to be lost. Turning on the switch before departure is an order of magnitude easier than regaining your account in the early morning in a foreign country.

Before departure

  • Confirm that the two-step verification and email address can be logged in from different locations.
  • App lock is on; lock high-sensitivity chats if necessary.
  • Complete the encrypted backup and confirm that the key is available offline.
  • Record the operator and international roaming loss reporting method, please refer to the official channels.
  • Tell your family: Check carefully any news about borrowing money while traveling.

on the road

  • Avoid hotel business centers keeping WhatsApp logged in.
  • Do not scan the QR codes for "Tax Refund", "Expedited Visa", "Free Tickets for Attractions" and unknown origins.
  • Use a rented mobile phone to log in to your main account with caution; log out after use and check related devices.
  • Block verification codes when entering in public environments; be wary of shoulder peeping and fake Wi-Fi portals.

48 hours after returning home

  1. Associated equipment cleaning, kicking off temporary travel sessions.
  2. If you have used a local SIM, confirm that there is no abnormal call transfer.
  3. Rotate 2-Step Verification PIN as appropriate.
  4. Review whether any suspicious links have been clicked during the trip, and reinforce them if so.

Write "clean up on the first day back home" in your unpacking list and put it alongside the laundry.

summary

Travel anti-theft = less frequent use of unfamiliar devices + no long sessions + review after returning home. Treat safety as a module of your journey, rather than something you have to make up for later.

eSIM and dual-SIM switching

After the travel eSIM is activated, confirm which card receives WhatsApp text messages; avoid the old card being copied by local profiteers while it is still inserted in the phone. After uninstalling the travel eSIM when you return home, recheck the two-step verification and associated devices to prevent QR codes scanned during roaming from leaving behind sessions.

If there is a portal login page for Wi-Fi on long-distance flights, pay attention to whether the brand is fake and induced to install the certificate.

Keep your ID and mobile phone separate

When your backpack is stolen, losing your mobile phone and passport together will make card replacement and identity verification even more difficult. Store them separately, and store the scanned passport in the cloud in an encrypted manner. When travel insurance covers equipment theft, the report number is important for claim settlement, and the terms of the policy shall prevail.

SIM vendor at border crossing

Port cheap SIMs may be programmed with malicious SMS forwarding. Try to purchase the card at the official airport counter and check the operator's app for service activation as soon as possible. Check related equipment on the first day you enter the country, don’t wait until you return home.

Summary retelling

Travel photo albums can be posted, but verification codes and login codes cannot. Before posting to Moments, check whether the screenshot is included in the OTP.

A calendar reminder will be set after the return ticket is issued: safe review on the day of landing.

Use the email prefix instead of the full number on the contact card hanging on your suitcase to reduce the chance that the number will be copied and used for social work.

Keep your passport and backup machine in the hotel safe, and keep your phone at eye level.

If you need to scan the QR code to bind a car rental GPS, use an unfamiliar car Wi-Fi connection and scan again.

When queuing up at customs on your return trip, don’t borrow a stranger’s mobile phone to make calls, and use anti-related equipment to scan the QR code.

In the first week after returning, the number of phone calls from strangers increased, keeping the threshold high.

Do not put a courier slip with your mobile phone number on the outside of the suitcase.

Do not allow strangers to check in at the hotspot when standing next to the tax refund queue at the airport.

30-master-checklist.title: HoldLine Anti-Theft Master Manual: 30-Day Hardening Plan and Lifetime Checklist
30-master-checklist.excerpt: Turn the first 29 into actionable plans: what to do today, this week, this month, every quarter, and a one-page process for the day it was stolen.
30-master-checklist.body:
After reading thirty articles but not taking action, the effect is approximately zero. This article compiles all the methods into a schedule: what you want today, what you want this week, what you want every quarter, and the "one page" on the day it was stolen. You can print it and put it on your wall, or set a recurring reminder in your calendar.

Today (must do within 60 minutes)

  1. Turn on two-step verification + recovery email + keep PIN safe.
  2. Check and clean associated devices.
  3. Sync with family members: No one will give you the verification code.
  4. System strong screen lock + WhatsApp app lock.
  5. Confirm that the client is from the official store.

Completed within this week

  1. The privacy page has been tightened one by one: avatar, group invitation, and status.
  2. If backup is needed, start end-to-end encrypted backup and keep the key.
  3. 15-minute family meeting: practice cheat codes and loan verification.
  4. Clean up unfamiliar groups and suspicious contacts.
  5. Business users take stock of who has access to the host device and computer sessions.

Extension this month

  • Help elders/young people complete the same basic reinforcement.
  • Ask your operator if they can add card replacement protection.
  • The whole family collects and regains the entrance to the process.
  • Evaluate chat lock and disappearing message strategies.

30-minute review every quarter

  • Scan the associated device again; optionally update the PIN.
  • Confirm that the email and backup keys are still accessible.
  • Review whether there were any code requests, fake votes, or screen sharing requests during the quarter.
  • Update emergency contact lists and family passwords.

One page on the day it was stolen

  1. This machine re-verifies the number and the registration code will not be transmitted externally.
  2. Clear associated devices and reset two-step verification.
  3. Notify relatives and friends via text messages/phone calls to stop losses.
  4. If you have lost money, contact your bank and, if necessary, go to the local police.
  5. Review the entrance and fill the gap.

Four sentences for life:The verification code is the key; the two-step verification is the second door; the associated equipment is the backdoor list; borrowing money and transferring money require double channel verification. Memorizing it is more effective than collecting thirty articles.

how to last

Select a family "digital contact" to be responsible for reminding quarterly reviews; the company can incorporate it into monthly IT reports. The value of a habit lies in repetition, not one-time perfection.

summary

The end point of the 30 HoldLine articles is not to become a researcher, but to turn sobriety into an agenda. If you complete the five must-do items today, you will have outperformed most users - leave the rest to your schedule to fill in slowly.

Embed lists into existing habits

Bind "Associated Device Check" to brushing your teeth; put "Quarterly PIN Rotation" on the same day as rent payment; the company can write reviews into the OKR security education completion rate. Automated reminders beat hard memorization.

If you only remember one of the 30 articles, please go back to the first verification code discipline; if you are willing to implement one article, please implement this timetable. Knowledge + schedule equals the real HoldLine.

Assess your own completion

Quarterly self-assessment: 0–3 points: verification code discipline, two-step verification, associated devices, backup keys, and transfer verification. Items with scores lower than 2 points will be given priority to make up classes next week. The points system is more honest than "seems to have done it all." Invite family members to evaluate each other and increase social supervision.

Version numbers and updates

This list and official App functions are based on the current common version. Scan the setting path again after major version updates. Add the HoldLine homepage to your browser favorites and review it every quarter to see if there are any new scam topics worth reading for the whole family.

01-singapore-spf-2024-06.title: Singapore police warns: WhatsApp account takeover scam is on the rise again
01-singapore-spf-2024-06.excerpt: Scammers use stolen accounts to ask for verification codes from address books, or use video calls to request screen sharing to peek at the six-digit code, and then pretend to be the victim to borrow money or defraud bank card information.
01-singapore-spf-2024-06.body:
On June 7, 2024, the Singapore Police Force issued an anti-fraud notice to remind the public to be alert to the reactivation of WhatsApp account takeover scams. The notice points out that after taking control of the victim's account, scammers will send messages to the victim's address book and use the excuses of "borrowing money" or "buying gift cards on behalf of others" to obtain transfers; in some cases, they will further ask for bank card photos and payment OTP, resulting in unauthorized deductions.

Two main types of techniques in notifications

  1. Familiar cheat code:The victim received a message from the "contact" claiming that the verification code was sent incorrectly and please help forward the six-digit number. The contact account has often been stolen.
  2. Screen sharing code:The scammer pretends to be a government or bank employee and initiates a video call, asking to share the screen to "verify information", and then triggers the WhatsApp verification code to be displayed on the screen for the other party to see.

official advice

  • Verification codes, bank information, and OTP will never be shared externally.
  • Be wary even of unusual requests from address book friends.
  • Use another way to verify your identity before making screen sharing requests.
  • Turn on two-step verification; set up a phone lock screen and be mindful of physical contact.

HoldLine Interpretation: This notice juxtaposes "cheating codes" and "reading codes from a distance", indicating that defense cannot just focus on "whether the numbers can be typed out and sent."

02-singapore-spf-2026-03.title: Singapore issues another notice: OTP serial fraud leads to continuous loss of accounts
02-singapore-spf-2026-03.excerpt: The scammer enters the victim's number to trigger the OTP, and then the "acquaintance" who has already stolen it asks for the code; after he succeeds, he copies the same words to attack the next contact.
02-singapore-spf-2026-03.body:
On March 12, 2026, SPF once again issued an anti-fraud alert regarding the hacking of WhatsApp accounts. The process is clearly written: the scammer first uses the victim's mobile phone number to try to log in → the system sends an OTP to the victim → a message from an acquaintance whose account has been lost, falsely claiming that "the verification code was originally mine, but it was sent to you by mistake" → the victim hands over the OTP and is kicked offline → the scammer uses a new account to continue to deceive the next person.

When do victims usually notice

  • You suddenly cannot log into WhatsApp; or
  • The friend informed "You are asking someone for a verification code."

Reinforcement actions highlighted in the announcement

  • Settings → Linked devices: Remove unknown devices.
  • Settings → Account → Two-Step Verification: Enable.
  • Work with official anti-fraud tools such as ScamShield to verify suspicious requests.

The notice stated that no monetary losses were collected at that time, but the loss of the account itself was enough to start the next round of fraud, and the social cost was still high.

03-singapore-spf-2026-10.title: Pretending to borrow money after account hacking: There were at least 128 cases in Singapore in two months, resulting in losses of approximately S$249,000.
03-singapore-spf-2026-10.excerpt: Since September 2026, after scammers took over WhatsApp and pretended to be relatives, friends, and colleagues to claim loans or make payments on their behalf, the police announced the number of cases and losses and reiterated ScamShield.
03-singapore-spf-2026-10.body:
The notice on October 21, 2026 shows: Since September of the same year, at least 128 cases have involved scammers taking control of WhatsApp and pretending to be the victims on social media/instant messaging to borrow money from contacts or ask for "help to transfer money", with cumulative losses of at least approximately S$249,000.

common excuses

  • The bank transfer limit has been reached, please pay on your behalf.
  • It is inconvenient to transfer the money yourself, so please borrow one first.
  • Pretend to be a child and demand payment for the "AI/Exchange Project" fee.

POLICE ADD-CHECK-TELL FRAMEWORK

  1. ADD:Install ScamShield to filter suspicious calls and text messages.
  2. CHECK:Use official channels to verify; call the person directly for abnormal transfer requests.
  3. TELL:Inform relatives, friends and authorities; if money has been transferred, contact your bank immediately and call the police.

HoldLine reminds: Account stealing is often only the first stage, and the second stage is to "monetize" the address book. Anti-theft and anti-loan measures should be done together.

04-switzerland-ncsc-2026-10.title: Switzerland NCSC: Voting fraud cases surged in October, with more than 50 related reports in a single month
04-switzerland-ncsc-2026-10.excerpt: An acquaintance's account sends a "Vote for the Kids" link, and the fake site receives a text message code or induces the user to scan the QR code of the associated device, resulting in takeover or silent synchronization.
04-switzerland-ncsc-2026-10.body:
NCSC stated in its 43rd weekly report in 2026 that reports of stolen/compromised WhatsApp accounts have increased significantly again; in October alone, more than 50 reports of such scams were received, and many attacks were successful. The core of the technique is "goodwill voting": the message comes from the accused account in the address book, urging you to open it in the name of canvassing votes for school or dance competition.

Two killer moves for fake sites

  1. It asks you to enter your mobile phone number and "SMS verification code" - which is actually a WhatsApp registration code. Filling it out will help the scammer activate your account on a new device.
  2. Display the QR code and induce scanning with an "associated device" - the account is still available, but the scammer's web page has been hung up.

Institutional recommendations

  • Even if you are canvassing for votes with an acquaintance, you should check through another channel first.
  • The verification code will not be transmitted externally or entered into the web page.
  • Only scan the QR code for the official web version on your own device.
  • Turn on two-step verification PIN.

NCSC reminds: Domain names will be constantly changed to bypass filtering, and you cannot rely on "remembering a bad URL" once and for all.

05-switzerland-ncsc-week21.title: There has been a wave of "fake contest voting" account thefts in Switzerland in the spring and summer, and it is back again in the fall.
05-switzerland-ncsc-week21.excerpt: The NCSC described the "vote your children" rhetoric as early as Week 21; the fall weekly report showed that similar attacks have expanded again, indicating that the rhetoric can be reused for a long time.
05-switzerland-ncsc-week21.body:
The Swiss NCSC has documented in a related weekly report in the spring: Victims receive messages from seemingly acquaintances asking to vote for a child's competition; after clicking, they fall into a scam and risk losing access to WhatsApp. By the fall (week 43), the agency clearly wrote that "this type of attack is not new, but the recent rise in reports suggests that it is becoming more useful."

Why should I remember this alone?

The same country, the same agency, and repeated warnings in two seasons prove that fake voting is not a one-time news, but a "mature product" that can be revived seasonally. In particular, family groups and school groups need to preset rules: canvassing links will be verified first by default.

Migration implications for Chinese users

The words can be localized into "helping to check in", "voting in lottery" and "charity co-branding". The structure remains unchanged: forwarding by acquaintances + short-term pressure + asking for or scanning the QR code. The 04th long article of HoldLine corresponds to this structure.

06-ireland-ncsc-2024-08.title: Ireland NCSC: CAPTCHA scam escalates, business WhatsApp exposure comes under scrutiny
06-ireland-ncsc-2024-08.excerpt: The advisory document details how scammers first take control of the accounts of acquaintances, and then create a sense of urgency to ask for verification codes; it also reminds that in business scenarios, the loss of accounts may lead to more data risks.
06-ireland-ncsc-2024-08.body:
Ireland's NCSC issued a WhatsApp verification code scam advisory in August 2024, describing the attack chain: obtain a mobile phone number → enter the number on the login page to trigger a real verification code → contact the victim through a lost contact identity → ask for the code on the pretext of emergency assistance → take over after success and continue to spread.

Special reminder: for business purposes

The document emphasizes that when corporate employees use WhatsApp to handle work, once the account is lost, not only private chats will be exposed, but also customer communication and internal coordination information. This is mutually confirmed with HoldLine’s “Business Account Special Topic”: Business accounts require stricter equipment and PIN storage systems.

core sentence

Verification codes should never be shared; WhatsApp won’t ask you for them, and neither should anyone else.

07-cayman-rcips-2024.title: Caribbean police continue to warn: fake local calls + AI voice imitation assists account theft
07-cayman-rcips-2024.excerpt: RCIPS said takeover scams continued; calls were being made from forged local area codes and there were reports of scammers using AI to mimic voices to create credibility.
07-cayman-rcips-2024.body:
The Royal Cayman Islands Police has issued multiple updated WhatsApp account takeover scam warnings in 2024. The August Notice reviews the classic path: creating panic through text messages/WhatsApp/phone calls → requesting six-digit verification codes → changing accounts → pretending to be the owner and defrauding contacts. The September update mentioned: Recently, victims have received calls that look like local (345) numbers, which are actually fake caller IDs from abroad; there are reports that accent features are obvious and there is AI deepfake audio imitation.

Police list "don'ts"

  • Don't reply to suspicious messages
  • Do not open attachments
  • Don't click on links in messages
  • Do not generate and send WhatsApp six-digit codes to anyone

International Trend Observation: Phone display numbers can be forged, and AI voices can be imitated—“sounding local/like me” no longer equals security.

08-trinidad-ttcsirt-2024-11.title: TTCSIRT: Brand Ambassador Voting is a fishing trick, and after success, the business information is changed and continues to spread
08-trinidad-ttcsirt-2024-11.excerpt: The attacker started by saying "Vote for me to be a brand ambassador" to defraud the verification code; after taking control of the account, he may change it to business information, and then phish the address book again.
08-trinidad-ttcsirt-2024-11.body:
The Trinidad and Tobago Cyber ​​Security Incident Response Team (TTCSIRT) warned in November 2024 of an ongoing WhatsApp phishing campaign. Examples of words include asking the other person to vote for you to become a brand ambassador, using a polite, friend-like tone.

attack phase

  1. Pretend to be someone you know and ask for "help."
  2. Trick victims into handing over MFA/verification codes.
  3. Complete account takeover.
  4. The information may be changed to a business image to increase the credibility of subsequent fraud.
  5. Launch the next round of phishing against the victim’s address book.

The advisory reminds us that the "Business Account" mark on the interface does not automatically equal a trusted merchant, especially when the other party suddenly changes their information and starts sending strange requests in groups.

09-hongkong-scmp-2024-04.title: Hong Kong warns of resurgence of instant messaging robberies: losses exceeded HK$20 million in the first quarter, 90% involved WhatsApp
09-hongkong-scmp-2024-04.excerpt: The Cybersecurity and Technology Crime Bureau announced 864 account hijacking cases in the first quarter, with losses of approximately HK$20.4 million; more than 90% involved WhatsApp.
09-hongkong-scmp-2024-04.body:
According to public reports, the Hong Kong police warned of the resurgence of instant messaging account hijacking scams around April 2024: 864 related cases were recorded in the first quarter of the same year, with a loss of approximately HK$20.4 million, of which more than 90% involved WhatsApp. Scammers obtain key information through phishing links and other methods to take over the account, and then read the address book to commit fraud.

Common local follow-up actions

  • Impersonate the victim to borrow money from relatives and friends or ask to buy point cards.
  • Use the tone of past chats to reduce suspicion.

defensive response

The police have always recommended: open two-step verification, check related equipment, click on links carefully, and call to verify before transferring money. Hong Kong users can also cooperate with official fraud detection tools such as Scameter.

10-hongkong-2025-03.source: Hong Kong Police (public social media notification)
10-hongkong-2025-03.title: In March 2025, there were 93 cases of WhatsApp hijacking, with losses exceeding 10 million Hong Kong dollars.
10-hongkong-2025-03.excerpt: The police remind people to be especially wary of "urgent requests for money from relatives and friends overseas"; they emphasize logging out of unknown devices, turning on two-step verification, not clicking on suspicious links, and not sharing verification codes.
10-hongkong-2025-03.body:
Relevant reports in April 2025 quoted police information: In March alone, 93 cases of WhatsApp account robberies were recorded, with losses exceeding HK$10 million. After taking over, the scammer studies the chat history, mimics the tone, and then fabricates a medical or travel emergency to force you to transfer money.

Four self-protection tips for the police (report summary)

  1. Log out of the unrecognized associated device and enable two-step verification.
  2. Do not click on suspicious links in WhatsApp.
  3. Never share passwords or verification codes.
  4. If a contact suddenly asks for money, call first to verify.

Figure description: Even if the overall number of fraud categories has subsequently declined, losses in the tens of millions in a single month are still enough to prove that the threat has not disappeared.

11-hongkong-2025-deepfake.source: Hong Kong police disclose the case (media reports)
11-hongkong-2025-deepfake.title: Huge case in Hong Kong: Hijacking WhatsApp + deepfake voices, involving about HK$145 million in a single case
11-hongkong-2025-deepfake.excerpt: Scammers monitor chats for a long time, impersonate company personnel and use deepfake technology to imitate voices, inducing victims to transfer virtual assets.
11-hongkong-2025-deepfake.body:
According to relevant case disclosures in 2025, one of the largest fraud cases in Hong Kong that year involved WhatsApp account hijacking, involving approximately HK$145 million.
